checkpoints.prompt: For lps-observation, reconstruct horizontal tag speed at the target row using the unfiltered three-point derivative. Report m/s and the position-only bounded-error radius, under the declared ideal measurement clock. Use method three-point. Include surrounding x/y/time evidence and cite DEV-005.
Judge eligibility of lps-invalid before calculating. Use method three-point and cite DEV-005.

methods.clock: Common exact measurement clock and zero latency
methods.geometry: Z-up field frame with declared synthetic anchors; horizontal tag trajectory
methods.qc: Production native admission, signal-valid flag, visibility and integrity checks
methods.eligibility: Contiguous native synthetic record, intact channels and supported interior row
methods.uncertainty: Conditional deterministic position-error radius from declared horizontal Euclidean bound per sample
limitations: Synthetic tracked-tag kinematics only. No Doppler, athlete center-of-mass, hardware metrology or interchangeability claim.
